blocks.text: SUBIC, Zambales — Zambales fisherfolk joined peasant women at a protest rally outside the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) on Thursday opposing a proposed United States ammunition factory in Subic, warning of its potential threats to coastal livelihoods, community safety and the marine environment. The protest, led by the Amihan Federation of Peasant Women with fisherfolk groups, marked the International Day of Rural Women and highlighted concerns over expanding US military-related activities in the Subic Bay Freeport and surrounding coastal communities.
